figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q) SELECT store_id,month_key,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) mom_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prior_year)/NULLIF(prior_year,0),2) yoy_pct,CASE WHEN fall3=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END three_declines FROM z WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY net_cents DESC

figures.title: 环比
figures.meaning: 把本月和上个月比较，看净销售是增长还是下降。

formula.numerator: 本月净销售 − 上月净销售

check.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q)  SELECT prev FROM z WHERE store_id=6 AND month_key='2025-12'

figures.interpretation: 环比 {result}：本月净销售比上个月变化的幅度；为正表示增长，为负表示下降。

notes.label: 易错口径
notes.text: 环比不是同比；相邻数据行不是天然相邻月份
分母为 0 时，结果为空（NULL），不会报错，也不会写成 0。

figures.title: 同比
figures.meaning: 把本月和去年同月比较，排除季节变化的影响，看净销售的变化。

formula.numerator: 本月净销售 − 去年同月净销售

check.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q)  SELECT prior_year FROM z WHERE store_id=6 AND month_key='2025-12'

figures.interpretation: 同比 {result}：本月净销售比去年同月变化的幅度；为正表示增长，为负表示下降。

notes.label: 易错口径
notes.text: 环比不是同比；相邻数据行不是天然相邻月份
分母为 0 时，结果为空（NULL），不会报错，也不会写成 0。

figures.title: 环比和同比，比较的是哪一个月？

check.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q)  SELECT ROUND(100.0*(net-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) FROM z WHERE store_id=6 AND month_key='2025-12'

panels.label: 同比：和去年同月比
panels.note: 同一家门店，把 2025-12 与 2024-12 放在一起，避开季节影响。

check.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q)  SELECT ROUND(100.0*(net-prior_year)/NULLIF(prior_year,0),2) FROM z WHERE store_id=6 AND month_key='2025-12'

figures.conclusion: 同一个月份，环比看相邻月份的变化，同比看去年同月的变化，两个比率的分母不同，不能互换。
